notes.title: Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/0fd49b3a9c7692016394486b763e4e2ed30d3ef7.png

Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business

Suit up. A new threat has taken over the OmniTower, and RoboCop is the only one who can stop it.

RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is a brand-new, standalone adventure set after the events of the main game and between the RoboCop 2 and 3 films. It brings back the explosive gameplay and atmosphere you loved, while introducing fresh challenges, new allies, and a deadly news enemies.

[previewyoutube=ibbgOXYagzs;full][/previewyoutube]
New faces. New allies. New enemies. One mission: justice.

You’ll reunite with key characters like Officer Anne Lewis, Sergeant Warren Reed, and ED-209. But standing in RoboCop’s way are dangerous new opponents like Cassius Graves or his right arm Douglas Cole.

Together, they’ve taken control of the OmniTower, a massive residential complex designed to rebuild Old Detroit. RoboCop must fight his way to the top to save innocent lives, and uncover the truth behind the siege.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527760/RoboCop_Rogue_City__Unfinished_Business/
What’s new in Unfinished Business?

A gripping new story set between RoboCop 2 and 3.
New characters and locations.
Powerful new weapons and brutal finish moves.
Speciales missions as Alex Murphy (voiced once again by Peter Weller), ED-209, other...

First press reviews

 GamesRadar+
"RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is more RoboCop but not just more. It's all dialled up. More action. More weapons. More over-the-top. I can't wait to see how high the OmniTower really stretches."

"I walked away eager to see what else RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business has in store when it arrives for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S on July 17, 2025."

"There’s still a lot to learn about how the story will land and how the Alex Murphy missions will play out. For now, however, it’s still hard to imagine any video game nailing the act of being RoboCop as well as this."

 "This is RoboCop: Rogue City with its pedal to the floor, confined and concentrated into a lean, tightly focused machine."

notes.title: New Game+ & more!
notes.content:
Greetings citizens!
We're glad to not only announce, but also launch a new major update for RoboCop: Rogue City!


New Game Plus is here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/fb203c60951a5a3527c733d9727c2dcf7cde0cc9.jpg

Re-live the journey with all of your previously unlocked skills and Auto-9 upgrades, for the full "invincible robotic law enforcement officer" experience.

To unlock the mode, just finish the game after the update is applied — this can be done by reloading a save made just before completing the game. Once done, a new save file will be created, and loading it will grant you access to NG+!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/614d6b5294f3e3f7c0ce0e150a1d60709c13a321.png

Alongside, a new Golden Auto-9 skin will be unlocked as soon as you beat the game. 

[hr][/hr]
But wait, there's more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/6cc631076ab282360616e62de3a894685aeac356.jpg

Coming along NG+ is a new difficulty level, making enemies deadlier.
If you're up for a challenge, time to try the "There Will be Trouble" difficulty!

[hr][/hr]
Changelog:

 Added a New Game Plus mode
 Added a new difficulty: "There Will be Trouble"
 Added a new unlockable Golden Auto-9 skin, available once NG+ is available
 Added more Auto-9 Chips and Boards
 Fixed the shooting mode not properly resetting when exiting interiors
 Fixed RoboCop's right hand disappearing when grabbing a human enemy while unaliving them
 Fixed the Stolen Vehicle investigation being skipped if Ben immediately opened the locker

notes.title: Rogue City is OUT NOW
notes.content:
It's time to bring justice to the crime-ridden streets of Old Detroit!

RoboCop: Rogue City is finally out on PC (Nov. 2, 1PM EDT / 5PM UTC / 6PM CET)!
We want to thank you all, the fans, for the incredible amount of support — and patience! — you've given us all this time, and we sincerely hope the game will be everything you wanted a RoboCop game to be.

So go and do what Alex Murphy does best! Explore the streets of Old Detroit, investigate, fight through dangerous situations and, most importantly... issue those parking tickets like the robot cop you are.

If you encounter issues during your playthrough, please let us know via our Steam Forums or our official Discord community. We'll be glad to assist you and find a fix as soon as possible.

notes.title: RoboCop: Rogue City - Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
Welcome to Detroit; crime runs rampant as the city lies on the edge of ruin, people fighting for scraps as others live extravagant lives of luxury. Control of the Detroit Police Department is given to the Omni Consumer Products corporation in an attempt to restore order. You are that solution, RoboCop, a cyborg tasked with protecting the city. 

Watch the Gameplay Reveal
[previewyoutube=jQ2hZ-4JCTE;full][/previewyoutube]
The triumphant return of RoboCop wouldn’t feel right without the man who brought so much life into the role, and we’re excited to reveal that Peter Weller will be performing voice-over work on the game. Enjoy this first look at gameplay and for the record, “dead or alive, you’re coming with me!” 

RoboCop: Rogue City will be coming to Steam in June 2023.
